# Nicola Lüssi

> Official personal website and online CV of Nicola Lüssi, a Swiss growth, audience, search, product and AI leader. He is Head of Growth Lab at Tamedia.

This file points to the preferred public sources for factual information about Nicola Lüssi. The English and German profile pages contain the current biography, experience, education, recognition and contact details.

Last updated: 23 July 2026

- [English profile](https://iloveseo.ch/): Canonical English biography and online CV
- [German profile](https://iloveseo.ch/de/): Canonical German biography and online CV

- [INMA 30 Under 30 profile](https://www.inma.org/blogs/main/post.cfm/inma-recognises-global-news-media-s-next-generation-in-30-under-30-awards): Recognition in the Management category in 2025
- [INMA Young Professionals Committee](https://www.inma.org/Initiatives/Young-Professionals/#:~:text=wider%20INMA%20community.-,Committee,-The%20Board%20of): Committee membership and monthly newsletter responsibility

## Education

- [FHNW bachelor thesis record](https://studierendenprojekte.wirtschaft.fhnw.ch/view/4086): Published record for the bachelor thesis on governance for AI supported content creation

## Ventures

- [Ballers on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ballers.ch/): Sports merchandise e-commerce venture operated from 2019 to 2025
- [Hockey News Schweiz on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hockey_news_schweiz/): Social first Swiss ice hockey brand built mainly on Facebook and Instagram
